text:
nina: FYI auditor follow-up from ACME-pro. They flagged a billing spike + 503s coinciding with a KMS key rotation window last week. Auditor wants chain-of-custody for key material, access logs for the rotation window, and a repro playbook. ticket TCK-4821. @emma could you own evidence packaging?

emma: ack. can you paste the exact time window and any sample request ids? need to scope log exports + S3 path. :eyes:

nina: customer says incident started around 2026-02-13T03:22:00Z and lasted ~18m. Sample request id from their app: req_8f3b2a. Billing team also saw a token surge 03:24-03:30.

raj: quick note — we did scheduled KMS rotation for keystore-k1 at 2026-02-13T03:25:00Z (orchestration service). Rotation steps: create new key, import, change key alias, retire old key. No HSM offline events recorded but I'll pull HSM logs just in case.

liam: support-bot attached ticket history: https://support.redwood.example/TCK-4821 (internal). Also S3 evidence bucket prefix we typically use: s3://redwood-evidence/ACME-pro/keystore/2026-02-13/

emma: thanks. here's what auditor explicitly asked for: 1) Keystore rotation manifest showing timestamps and actor ids 2) KMS/HSM access logs (creation/import/alias-change) 3) API auth logs correlated with request ids 4) Billing token usage summary 5) Repro instructions to recreate observed 503 in a dev sandbox.

maya: (auditor) pls confirm that exported logs include correlation ids and the full chain (orchestration -> kms -> hsm). CSV or ndjson is fine. Also need retention policy reference for these logs (where documented and TTL).

raj: pulling logs now. quick grep snippet from keystore service at 03:25:02Z:
```
[2026-02-13T03:25:02Z] INFO keystore: rotation_started key=keystore-k1 actor=orchestration svc=keymgr trace=req_8f3b2a
[2026-02-13T03:25:12Z] INFO kms: create_key key_id=abcd-1234 actor=orchestration svc=kms trace=req_8f3b2a
[2026-02-13T03:25:35Z] INFO hsm: import_key key_id=abcd-1234 slot=3 actor=hw-operator trace=req_8f3b2a
[2026-02-13T03:25:58Z] INFO kms: update_alias alias=keystore-k1 -> abcd-1234 actor=orchestration trace=req_8f3b2a
[2026-02-13T03:26:10Z] INFO keystore: rotation_complete key=keystore-k1 actor=orchestration trace=req_8f3b2a
```

raj: HSM console shows no connection drops; will export full ndjson slice for 03:20-03:40.

liam: billing pulled token usage: 03:20-03:35 token_count=1.2M (baseline ~120k). spike aligns with rotation window. adding billing delta CSV to evidence.

emma: repro playbook idea: reproduce a race where in-flight requests hit alias-change midway through token validation. Create a dev keystore, trigger alias swap while running continuous auth requests. Sample curl load:
```
while true; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY_REDACTED" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate?model=redwood-1 >> /dev/null; done
# in parallel, call alias change API:
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer OP_KEY_REDACTED" https://internal-keystore/api/v1/alias/swap -d '{"alias":"keystore-k1","new_key":"abcd-1234"}'
```

maya: good. auditor needs a written repro step doc and a short playback of logs showing the 503s timestamped against alias-change events. Also need mapping of which team performed rotation (actor ids) and change approvals.

nina: customer says they saw 503 responses with body: {"error":"auth_failure","code":503}. sample captured request-id header: req_8f3b2a. attached screenshot in ticket.

emma: OK I'll assemble a packet: 
- S3 export: keystore rotation manifest (ndjson)
- HSM audit logs slice (ndjson)
- API gateway auth logs slice with request ids and response codes (ndjson)
- Billing delta CSV + per-route token histogram
- Repro playbook + short runbook to run in staging
Expect a tarball in S3 by EOD UTC. Anyone object to that timeline?

raj: no objections. I'll upload HSM + KMS extracts to s3://redwood-evidence/ACME-pro/keystore/2026-02-13/hsm_kms_slice.ndjson and post presigned link here when done.

liam: billing CSV will be s3://redwood-evidence/ACME-pro/billing/2026-02-13/billing_delta.csv. I'll include token-level breakdown and a note about our token-metering window.

maya: auditor note — please include the SOC 2 control reference numbers (CC6.1, CC7.3) in the package metadata and a statement of retention policy (logs TTL + archival location). Auditor expects proof of when logs were first written (not just exported now).

emma: added to checklist. raj — can you include original object timestamps/ETags so we can prove original write times?

raj: yes will include S3 object metadata and keystore service write timestamps. Upload in ~45m.

support-bot: Ticket TCK-4821 updated: evidence package upload in progress. Status -> evidence_collected.

nina: thanks all. I'll reply to customer and CC auditor: timeline + expected delivery and attach repro steps. Please ping if you find any missing artifacts. :thumbsup:
